variants.cost: One current-loss gradient evaluation per observed round. Up to one exact generalized projection per update producing the next decision: T-1 for T played decisions, or T if also constructing x_{T+1}. O(n^2) dense arithmetic per update and O(n^2) storage, excluding gradient evaluation, projection solver cost and representation of P. No Hessian evaluation. Arithmetic count is not bit complexity or a total polynomial-time claim for arbitrary P.
variants.name: Online Newton Step, Figure 3
variants.output: Feasible decision sequence x_1,...,x_T; no averaging, random selection, sparsity or support restriction is imposed.
public_inputs: Nonempty closed bounded convex P subset R^n, n>=1; its positive diameter D
Uniform Euclidean gradient bound G>0 and exp-concavity parameter alpha>0
Initial feasible x_1 in P and access to exact generalized projections; horizon not needed
variants.query_and_update: At round t play x_t before observing f_t; receive g_t=grad f_t(x_t). Set A_t=A_{t-1}+g_t g_t^T. When a next decision is required, set y_{t+1}=x_t-beta^(-1)A_t^(-1)g_t and x_{t+1}=argmin_{x in P}(x-y_{t+1})^T A_t(x-y_{t+1}). For dense inverse maintenance use B_t=B_{t-1}-(B_{t-1}g_t g_t^T B_{t-1})/(1+g_t^T B_{t-1}g_t), so B_t=A_t^(-1).
variants.requirements: P and losses satisfy §2.2: twice differentiable convex scalar losses f_t:P->R with exp(-alpha f_t) concave on P and ||grad f_t(x)||_2<=G for all t,x. Exact gradient at each played point; exact minimization of each A_t-metric projection. No Hessian query required.
variants.state_and_initialization: Set beta=0.5 min{1/(4GD),alpha}, epsilon=1/(beta^2 D^2), A_0=epsilon I_n and B_0=epsilon^(-1) I_n. Choose any x_1 in P. Maintain x_t and A_{t-1}, or its inverse B_{t-1}; all A_t are positive definite.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Use the fixed beta and epsilon above. No horizon-dependent tuning or internal stopping test. Stop when the online interaction ends; a terminal x_{T+1} can be defined for the Proof without playing it.
